g.text: Projection from measured Hashformers-DistilGPT2 T4 throughput (14.11/s), $0.35/T4-hour with a 60s minimum, official standard API token prices, and a 100-item token profile. Hosted API latency and 90% accuracy are explicit scenarios, not measurements.
